$comment: Owning contract: contracts/artifact-manifest.schema.json per ROADMAP.md §0.4, Paper IV §6.6. Artifact manifest — digest-bound manifest of inspectable output (glossary: Artifact). Binds INV-E2 (packet revision matches artifact revision) to bytes. RATIFIED v1.0.0 by HgX 2026-10-21 (open question Q7): normative. Content unchanged from the v0.1 drafts; the seven drafts now stand as the ratified contract set.

digest.description: Content digest of the artifact (SHA-256, 64 hex chars). Fluent text not observed against its acceptance test is not an artifact (glossary: Artifact)

location.description: Where the artifact bytes live (path or URI)

media_type.description: Media type of the artifact (e.g. application/pdf, text/markdown)

provenance.description: Which worker produced it, from which sources, under which brief revision (Paper IV §6.6)

revision.description: Work-item revision the artifact is bound to (INV-E2; glossary: Revision)

work_id.description: Work item that produced the artifact

title: ArtifactManifest
